Name: Nixx-ZiNc-EX
Description: Download, update and launch integration for ZiNc EX, the launcher of the ZiNc 1.1 arcade emulator (Sony ZN-1 / ZN-2 boards: Capcom, Taito FX-1, Namco System 11 / 12, Tecmo, Konami GV...).
Credits: Many thanks to Hazem Abdelghani, who wrote ZiNc EX, and to The_Author, DynaChicken, R. Belmont and smf, who wrote ZiNc.
